rhythm.value: Detector: 29 shots, 28 cuts, median 1.27 s. Corrected (by looking): 36 shots, 35 cuts, median 0.73 s, 37.2 cuts a minute, but the film is two tempos. Outside the montage the 16 shots have a median of 2.39 s (long typed holds of 2-5 s and one 15.7 s closing plate). The 6.73-14.07 s montage is 20 shots with a median of 0.14 s and a near-monotonic accelerando: 1.47, 1.53, 0.88, 0.62, 0.45, 0.45, 0.47, 0.25, 0.17, 0.15, 0.12, 0.13, 0.12, 0.10, 0.10, 0.07, 0.10, 0.03, 0.03, 0.10 s (small reversals at the 2nd, 7th, 12th and last steps). The film is bracketed by black: 7 frames at 4.73 s and 0.57 s at 16.93 s. I cannot hear the film. audio.json tempo is 141.3 BPM at confidence 0.153 (beatRegularity 0.947): too weak to build a grid on. Detector sync: cutsOnBeatRatio 0.286 vs chance 0.362 (lift 0.79), cutsOnOnsetRatio 0.679 vs chance 0.513 (lift 1.32), cutsOnDownbeatFrameRatio 0.071 vs 0.021 (lift 3.38, but that is 2 of 28 cuts), signedMedianCutToBeatSec -0.005. Recomputed on the 35 corrected cuts: on beat 9/35 = 0.257 vs 0.362, on onset 24/35 = 0.686 vs 0.512, on a downbeat within 1 frame 1/35 vs 0.019. Onsets run at 3.77 a second (median gap 0.185 s), above the one-per-0.3 s limit, so the onset ratios mean nothing; per section the montage has 5.1 onsets a second and 15 of 22 cuts near one against 69% chance. Loudness swells (50 ms RMS, local maximum over ±0.3 s, above 1.35x median): 51 found, 5 of 35 cuts within 0.1 s of one against 18% chance. No evidence the cuts follow the music. The one measured sound-picture link is quiet under black: RMS about -69 dB at 16.0-16.5 s while the word holds, audio.json silence 16.98-17.45 s while the picture is black (16.93-17.5 s), and RMS -34 to -27 dB at 3.5-5.0 s around the first cut to black. The speech layer returned no words, so no voice is established.
evidence: Recomputed in the analyst's scratch folder on edit.json corrections applied with src/lib/reference/corrected.ts

value.name: doubling-counter-accelerando
value.description: A held layout (query strip, count, seated subject, plural label, name card) where every cut swaps the subject and doubles the count, 1 to 524 288 over 20 shots in 7.33 s. Holds 1.47, 1.53, 0.88, 0.62, 0.45, 0.45, 0.47, 0.25, 0.17, 0.15, 0.12, 0.13, 0.12, 0.10, 0.10, 0.07, 0.10, 0.03, 0.03, 0.10 s: falling, with small reversals. The picture cut leads the number: the new face lands 1-3 frames before the odometer roll starts (F584 vs F585, F701 vs F704, F728 vs F730, F756 vs F757, F771 vs F773), and each roll takes 4-5 frames. Some swaps pass through 2-4 frame flashes of a dark-ground ghost, an inverted plate or a cyan x-ray of the subject.
value.why: The eye never travels: face, number and card sit in the same places every cut, so a 2-frame shot still reads as one more result. Leading the number with the face makes the viewer see a person first and the count second, and the shrinking holds turn growth into felt pressure until the picture tears.

value.name: caret-tracking-typewriter
value.description: Text types at about 2 frames a character (10 characters in F93-F114) while the frame follows the caret: the field is framed so tight that the line overflows the left edge (OCR box x 0.00), the block caret stays near x 0.30-0.40. The newest word is accent red for 6-7 frames before turning to the base colour (F292-F298, F304-F309, F864-F869). Reused at 4.73-6.73 s on black, at 14.07-14.97 s, and in the interface at 22.1-24.6 s and 28.1-35.0 s.
value.why: The caret is the only place to look, so the reader reads at the typing speed and no eye travel is needed; the red flag on the last word marks what was just added, which is what each clause of a query is.

evidence: speech-text.json screenText boxes x 0.00 at 0.42-1.72 s and 23.8-24.6 s

value.name: polarity-slice-glitch-cut
value.description: Changes of section go through one-frame polarity flips (black ground to white and back) and horizontal slice displacement: 6.53-6.93 s is 24 frames (white F392-F394, slices F395-F399, white F400-F402, sliced person F404-F415, clean F416). Short forms: 1 frame at 1.92 s (F115), 4 frames at 5.50 s (F330-F333, with a scale jump), 7 frames at 14.97 s (F898-F905), 18 frames at 16.63-16.93 s ending in black.
value.why: A flip to the opposite ground is the strongest possible change in a single frame, so it reads as a hit even without sound; slicing the incoming image keeps the next subject unreadable for a moment, which makes its clean frame land as an arrival.

value.name: black-silence-reset
value.description: After the corrupted word smears out (last white frame F1015), 0.57 s of pure black (F1016-F1049) sits on the film's only measured silence (16.98-17.45 s); the brand mark glitches in at F1050 (17.50).
value.why: After 7 s of acceleration the viewer needs an empty frame to separate problem from answer; black plus silence resets attention so the first brand frame is read as a new chapter.

value.name: defocus-to-end-card
value.description: No cut into the end card: the person stands and walks out to the right in the same plate, the whole frame defocuses from about 48.3 s (chair and wall soften with him), and the mark pops in at F2936 (48.93) and the wordmark types on at about 3 frames a letter (F2954-F2975) over the blur; the offer pill follows at 50.4 s.
value.why: The payoff subject leaves the frame instead of being cut away, so the brand takes the place he held; the blur keeps the studio as a calm ground without competing with the type.
